props.caption: Poland. Two ambassadors resigned after the tribunal leadership was temporarily relieved of duty.
Strait of Hormuz. Oman says it evacuated 25 people from the burning crude tanker RITI.
Binance says it replenished approximately 90% of cryptocurrency stolen in the 29 October hack.

items.note: Poland’s ambassadors to China and Romania resigned after a dispute over appointments to the Constitutional Court escalated overnight.
Oman says it evacuated 25 people from the burning crude tanker RITI in the Strait of Hormuz.

lead.what: Poland’s ambassadors to China and Romania resigned after the tribunal leadership was temporarily relieved of duty.

rest.what: A Miami judge dismissed with prejudice Trump’s $10bn defamation claim against the Wall Street Journal, Dow Jones and Rupert Murdoch.

lead.what: Oman says it evacuated 25 people from the burning crude tanker RITI in the Strait of Hormuz.

rest.what: Binance says it replenished approximately 90% of cryptocurrency stolen in the 29 October hack.

lead.what: Novaya Gazeta says it will end its remaining operations in Russia on 9 November after an eviction from its Moscow offices.
